verdict.rationale: Gmail documents rule-based routing of incoming mail: filters match on sender, subject, or size and automatically add or remove labels or forward to a specified address. There is no documented way to assign a conversation to a teammate or mark an explicit owner. Delegation only grants another person access to the whole account, which is adjacent, not assignment. Missing for 10: conversation assignment to teammates, explicit ownership tracking, team routing (e.g., round-robin or assign-to-user rules), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit

citations.quote: When a message matches, filters automatically trigger actions such as adding or removing labels, or forwarding the email to a specified address.
Advanced rules configured for an account that evaluate incoming messages against specific matching criteria (like sender, subject, or size).
After you search, you can use the results to set up a filter for these messages.
